description: This file defines a generic interface for converting objects to and from JSON within the Fineract project. It provides method signatures for converting JSON input to objects and for serializing objects to JSON, along with a method to retrieve the type of object handled.

classes.name: JsonConverter
classes.description: A generic interface for converting between JSON and objects, parameterized by type T.

methods.name: convertToObject
methods.description: Converts JSON data from a JsonParser into an object of type T.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into JSON using a JsonGenerator.

methods.name: convertedType
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the type T that this converter handles.
